settlement_source: The Weather Company portal https://weather.com/kalshi 'Daily Climate' tab, row NYC — which per its footer relays the NWS Daily Climate Report CLINYC (WFO OKX) with CF6 as backup; TWC does not originate or adjust. CLINYC = Central Park ASOS KNYC (Belvedere Castle), NOT LGA/JFK/EWR. Rulebook GLOBALTEMPERATURE.pdf lists sources TWC > NWS > national met service.
settlement_variable: Daily MAX temperature, whole °F, local calendar day, as printed on the first official non-preliminary CLINYC (~1–4 AM local next day). CLI max comes from the ASOS continuous 1-minute sensor and can exceed the highest hourly METAR (2026-10-26: prelim CLI max 69 at 2:34 PM vs hourly METAR max 68).
timezone: America/New_York local day (CLI uses LST). close_time 05:00Z next day (1 AM EDT); expected_expiration 19:00Z next day; hard expiration ~7 days.
tie_handling: Integers, no ties: '>67' == '68 or above'; '<60' == '59 or below'; between bands inclusive; bands+tails partition the integers.
rounding: Whole °F from the CLI at source precision; ASOS produces °F internally — converting METAR tenths-°C yourself can differ by ±1°F; METAR body °C is coarser (1°C≈1.8°F). rules_secondary warns preliminary TWC values may differ by rounding/conversion.
trading_close_vs_settlement: Trading closes 05:00Z AFTER the local day ends: the full day's METAR/ASOS record and the ~4:33 PM preliminary CLI are public while trading is open; only post-4 PM maxima (rare) remain unresolved. Final CLI ~2:30–3:30 AM EDT (observed 06:36Z), ~1.5 h after close. settlement_timer 300 s; can_close_early true.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Material-error hold at Kalshi's sole discretion until revision or Expiration Date; no data by Expiration Date -> ALL strikes resolve to Kalshi's 'last fair price' (not void); 'Final' on TWC portal non-binding; only first non-preliminary report counts; Market Outcome Review 7.1; exchange may specify station; source-agency employees/MNPI barred.
title_vs_rules_divergences: 'NYC' = Central Park KNYC only; airports differ by several °F on sea-breeze/UHI days
'>67°' vs '68° or above' equivalent only because integer
Ticker 'B66.5' encodes band 66–67 inclusive, not a half-degree threshold
'according to The Weather Company' but TWC relays the NWS CLI
Rulebook 10 AM ET expiration / 3-month window / last trade 11:59 PM vs live params 3 PM EDT expected expiration, 7-day expiry, 1 AM EDT close
TWC portal hourly °F values ran 1–4°F below METAR-derived values on 2026-10-26 and are NOT the settlement figure

toxicity_flags: Preliminary CLI at ~4:33 PM reveals the official max-so-far while trading runs to 1 AM — adverse selection against resting orders after ~4:45 PM
Hourly METAR max under-reads the CLI max by 0–2°F; boundary strikes decided by this gap
KNYC ASOS often '$' flagged, outages → delayed/erroneous CLI → discretionary material-error hold
No data → 'last fair price' at Kalshi discretion, not refund
Station mismatch risk (apps quote LGA/JFK/EWR or TWC forecasts)
Rulebook timing text conflicts with live market parameters
DST days: 23/25-h local day; 05:00Z = midnight EST vs 1 AM EDT
notes: Verified live 2026-10-26: 6 open Oct-27 markets; TWC portal lists 48 cities with Status column; NYC Oct 25 = Max 64 Min 43 Final. Best proxy ordering: preliminary CLI (exact) > METAR 6-hourly max remarks > hourly METAR T-group > TWC hourly tab. Only the first non-preliminary CLI counts.
